A '''group''' of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[airborne infantry]] that was under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[clone battalion commander]] [[CRC-09/571|Seven-One]] was active during the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. The group participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], during which it led a frontal assault against [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Core ship/Legends|core ships]]. Following the battle, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Seven-One was transferred to lead another [[Seven-One's battalion|unit]] of the GAR.<ref name="Shatterpoint" />
